screen.script:
n = 0
function ogui_on_load() -- once, right after this chunk ran ogui.set("count", "text", tostring(n)) ogui.log("counter: loaded") end
function ogui_on_show() -- every time the screen comes forward ogui.after(0.5, function() -- one-shot: fires from the frame loop ogui.toast("counter pronto") end) end
function ogui_on_click(key) -- clicks with no C++ binding land here if key == "inc" then n = n + 1 elseif key == "dec" then n = n - 1 end ogui.set("count", "text", tostring(n)) ogui.set("meter", "value", math.max(0, math.min(1, n / 10))) end
function ogui_on_update(t, dt) -- every frame -- a slow drift keeps the meter alive without a hand-written loop end
